about: The hook-free package of method skills that scripts/build_directory_package.py builds. `skills` is what it holds, `left_out` is what failed its check and why, and `manifest` is its Codex manifest; the build adds the repository's version. The images the manifest names are kept in directory-package/ beside this file, and the package carries them under assets/. See references/directory-package.md.

left_out.synthesis-skill-router: Its routing table names synthesis-repo-guard, synthesis-git-hooks and synthesis-message-guard as the routes to protect a repository, install policy hooks and enforce message safety, and this package can do none of the three.

manifest.name: synthesis-skills-methods
manifest.description: The writing, review, planning and thinking methods of synthesis engineering: skills for drafting and checking prose, fact-checking, planning and reviewing code, and working through a decision. They work without the synthesis runtime. This package has no guards, no board and no rituals: nothing in it checks a send, a deploy or a commit, coordinates sessions or runs a daily routine. The full system, with all of that, installs from its marketplace on GitHub: https://github.com/synthesisengineering/synthesis-skills
